title: Stop
description: Stop record (Hold): scope, effects from a closed list, a reason from reasons.yaml, a deadline or until released, author (HLD-1). The core writes the id, author, source and record time. A stop of the farm and seat scopes is a record of the service tenant farm, the others are records of the tenant of their scope (TEN-1). Final stops remain records of the metadata class.

tenant.description: Tenant of the record: farm for the farm and seat scopes.

scope.description: Stop scope: a kind from the closed list spec/model/holds.yaml, the tenant and the name of the scope object. The farm scope has no tenant and no name; the tenant scope has no name.

name.description: Name of the scope object: role, task type, worker id, plugin, action, channel, machine, resource, bot group, bot, seat, schedule or case.

effects.description: Stop effects from the closed list spec/model/holds.yaml (kind: effect); pause_action since v0.2.

until.description: Deadline by the store clock, or null: until released (TIM-1).

source.description: Source of a code hold: an auto-stop rule from holds.yaml, an incident class or system:monitor.

seat_epoch.description: Seat epoch for a stop by the holder of the farm manager seat.

ended_at.description: When the stop expired or was released.

scope_kind.description: Scope kind (holds.yaml, kind: scope). The schedule and governance scopes since v0.2.

author_kind.description: Rank of the author for release (holds.yaml, kind: rank) or contain_auto for a code hold.
